deviations: The `_` catch-all arm of analytic_ff became unreachable once every (CanonicalSurface, CanonicalSurface) ordered pair is dispatched: the 8 plane-involved arms, the 8 curved×curved arms (CylCyl/CylCone×2/CylSphere×2/ConeCone/ConeSphere×2) and the `(Torus, _) | (_, Torus) | (Placed, _) | (_, Placed)` arm partition all 36 ordered pairs. It was removed (rustc flagged it `unreachable_patterns`) and the match is now exhaustive; the Torus/Placed deferred arm is retained unchanged and every new deferred arm returns the same `Err(Refusal::UnsupportedEnvelope(EnvelopeCase::ContactReductionDeferred))` the catch-all used to.
notes: Dispatch table landed in `analytic_ff` (contact/mod.rs). (Cylinder, Cylinder): axes exactly equal -> coaxial(&CoaxialPair::CylCyl(a,b)); axes unequal -> parallel_cylinders(a,b). (Cylinder, Cone) -> coaxial(&CoaxialPair::CylCone(a,b)) when the cylinder center (x,y) equals the cone apex (x,y), else deferred; (Cone, Cylinder) mirrors it as CylCone(b,a). (Cylinder, Sphere)/(Sphere, Cylinder) -> coaxial(&CoaxialPair::CylSphere(a,b)) / CylSphere(b,a) when the sphere center (x,y) equals the cylinder axis (x,y), else deferred. (Cone, Cone): apexes equal -> coaxial(&CoaxialPair::ConeCone(a,b)), else deferred. (Cone, Sphere)/(Sphere, Cone) -> coaxial(&CoaxialPair::ConeSphere(a,b)) / ConeSphere(b,a) when the sphere center (x,y) equals the cone apex (x,y), else deferred. 'deferred' is Err(Refusal::UnsupportedEnvelope(EnvelopeCase::ContactReductionDeferred)). The coaxiality predicate is `coaxial_axes(axis0: Point3, axis1: Point3) -> bool { axis0.x == axis1.x && axis0.y == axis1.y }` — exact f64 equality on the carrier axis positions (cylinder center, cone apex, sphere center), matching CoaxialPair::validate (coaxial.rs:79-101); no intervals, no tolerance, so a 1-ulp-apart (x,y) is not coaxial and routes to the parallel/deferred arm. The dispatch predicate guarantees validate() passes, so a NonCanonicalCarrier refusal from coaxial is propagated as a bug, not hidden. Certificate shape unchanged: `let Certified { value, .. } = outcome?;` then analytic_records(&value) + explicit field-by-field Certificate { props: {Prop::AnalyticCarrier: True}, method: Method::Exact, budget_left: *budget, margin: Margin::UNBOUNDED, modulus: Modulus::Unbounded }; nothing is spent from budget, and the coaxial/parallel_cylinders inner certificates are discarded via the Certified { value, .. } pattern. equal_radius_cylinders is NOT wired: it solves equal-radius cylinders with intersecting axes, a cell canonical carriers cannot reach — every canonical Cylinder/Cone axis is the z direction, so two are always parallel, never intersecting; that cell needs a rotated (Placed) cylinder, which the funnel defers. It remains the analytic-cell oracle for BG-NUM-003. Torus stays deferred (existing Torus arm untouched). Tests added (6, all in contact/mod.rs tests): contact_ff_cylinder_cylinder_parallel_returns_two_lines (offset d=1.5, r0=r1=1 -> one Arc1/Transverse record, Analytic(TwoCurves([Line, Line]))); contact_ff_cylinder_cylinder_coaxial_returns_empty (r=1 and r=2, same axis -> Ok with empty contacts); contact_ff_cylinder_cone_coaxial_returns_analytic (cyl (0,0,0) r=1, cone apex (0,0,0) tan(atan(3/4)) -> one Arc1 Analytic record) plus the metamorphic commutativity assertion contact(cyl,cone) == contact(cone,cyl) structurally (Debug-equality of the certified ContactComplex); contact_ff_cylinder_sphere_coaxial_returns_analytic (cyl r=1, sphere center (0,0,0) r=2 -> Arc1 Analytic record); contact_ff_cone_cone_coaxial_returns_analytic (apexes (0,0,0) tan 3/4 and (0,0,1) tan 1/2 -> one Arc1/Transverse record, Analytic(TwoCurves(_))); contact_ff_non_coaxial_curved_pair_refuses_deferred (cyl (0,0,0) r=1 x cone apex (1,0,0) and cyl x sphere center (2,0,0) both refuse ContactReductionDeferred). Tests build carriers directly per the packet: Cylinder::new(center, radius).expect(..).value, Cone::new(apex, tan_value.atan()) with the coaxial test module's dyadic convention (tan(atan(3/4)) == 3/4, tan(atan(1/2)) == 1/2 exactly in f64), Sphere::new, via the existing face() helper (unit (u,v) box). No float tolerance literals added (matches!-only assertions, no 1e-N). No in-scope representation was infeasible: the four reachable same-axis cells and the offset cylinder×cylinder cell all have exact closed forms already landed in the analytic modules; the offset mixed curved pairs are honestly deferred.
